name: SILL
verdict: SILL (Société Industrielle Laitière du Léon), flagship of the Breton family agri-food federation SILL Entreprises, founded in 1962 by the Falc'hun and León families and still run by them. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: registry shows Sebastien Floch Président de SAS with Tristan Falc'hun and Henri León (the founding families) as Directeurs Généraux. No state or fund stake found → none.
